description: This Java class defines the FeaturePropertiesDeletedStrategy, a final class implementing an event handling strategy for FeaturePropertiesDeleted events within the Eclipse Ditto project. It extends an abstract base class and overrides a method to remove feature properties from a ThingBuilder object in response to the event.

classes.name: FeaturePropertiesDeletedStrategy
classes.description: Immutable class implementing event handling for FeaturePropertiesDeleted events, extending AbstractThingEventStrategy.

methods.name: applyEvent
methods.description: Overrides the method to handle FeaturePropertiesDeleted event by removing feature properties from the ThingBuilder.
